name: D3D12 steady-state FPS static audit

goal.objective: Find and prioritize current GPU translation/generated-shader bottleneck candidates after P1 without modifying implementation.
criteria: All eight source domains have explicit checked-angle and file coverage.
Each retained finding has verified source location, trigger, cost domain and counterevidence; no unmeasured FPS claim.
Necessary D3DMetal comparison uses verified pristine hash and bounded REA call paths.
Independent verification challenges findings and final response identifies priority, remedy and discriminating measurement.

capacity: Native task scheduler controls concurrency; no cap advertised.

nodes.solutionSpace: Read-only source discovery with bounded evidence; lead owns cross-domain causal judgment.
nodes.task: TASK: Audit QueueSync for avoidable costs affecting D3D12 game FPS. DELIVERABLE: Return <=2200 words containing (1) coverage file list and 8-12 specific angles checked including negative findings, (2) strongest 3-6 candidates with exact file:line, caller-to-cost chain, activation condition, CPU/GPU/startup/steady classification, confidence, existing optimization/counterevidence, minimum safe remedy and measurement that could falsify it, (3) one focused D3DMetal comparison question if useful. SCOPE: Read-only src/d3d12/d3d12_command_queue.cpp, d3d12_fence.cpp, owned_submission_ring.hpp, owned_queue_task_fifo.hpp and src/winemetal native queue/command-buffer bridge; may read direct adjacent declarations/callers and existing evidence. Focus: Queue FIFO, batching, GPU/CPU waits, inter-queue serialization, residency, completion, excessive commits and lost GPU overlap. Exclude render grouping internals owned by RenderPass. HARD boundary: no edits, builds, runtime launches, REA calls or other repositories. VERIFY: Re-read each cited region and its enabling caller using read/search; separate confirmed code behavior from inferred performance. STOP WHEN: scoped paths and 8-12 angles have dispositions and each retained candidate has cited trigger and cost evidence.
nodes.verdict: Source audit complete; see findings.ko.md for corrected dispositions.
